reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1001 for 3003 receivers. The lower bound 1001 comes from an independent set; the upper bound 1001 from a linear code over F_5 with c=1 (one code tried). All four checks passed: independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding. The agent took 21.999 s wall (17.908 s LLM, 4.091 s compute). Baselines: CP-SAT alpha reached 1001 but was not proven in 123.3 s; CP-SAT cover, fractional cover and F2 min-rank (lower 1000) did not certify it. The earlier kushagra_agent also proved 1001 with field 5 in 4.38 s, so it was faster than this agent. Nothing suspicious.
